title: AttemptReceipt
description: Attempt Receipt (MODEL-SWITCHING-SCORECARD.md §42). NOT a standalone file or artifact: this schema describes the `data` object of the append-only ledger envelope event `usage.receipt` (ARTIBOT-5.0-DESIGN.md §8.2 §4·§42 — 'usage.receipt 이벤트 = Attempt Receipt', 동일 개체). One receipt per Run, and a Run is one spawn (§7.2), so run_id also joins to RouteReceipt.routing_epoch_id. The single writer is economics/usage-receipt.js (design §3.6): cache-roi.js and token-usage.js must not double-count. Beyond §42 this schema carries exactly the three additions lane 2 §4.5 prescribes — usage.source, usage.requests and cost.pricing_version — because a receipt without a source grade contradicts the §46 EXACT/PARTIAL/SIMULATED labelling rule. additionalProperties is false at every level.

schema_version.description: Receipt schema revision. Bumped only on a breaking field change.

run_id.description: The Run this attempt belongs to. One spawn = one Run (§7.2), so this equals the spawn id and joins to RouteReceipt.routing_epoch_id (lane 2 §4.5 G1).

action_id.description: Optional. Transcript entries carry no mission or action id (lane 2 §2.4): attribution is reliable to the spawn, and a main-thread turn can only be attributed to an action by joining requestId + timestamp against the decision trail (accuracy unverified). Omit rather than guess.

model_identity.description: Exact identity of the model that ran the attempt (§20, §42). Resolved from the transcript message.model, never from the tier alias.

usage.description: Token usage for the attempt, mapped from lane 2 §2.4: fresh_input_tokens = input_tokens, cached_input_tokens = cache_read_input_tokens, cache_creation_tokens = cache_creation_input_tokens, thinking_tokens = output_tokens_details.thinking_tokens. A writer normalises a missing counter to 0; a missing REQUIRED transcript key instead downgrades the entry to source: estimate and increments receipt.parseFailures.

source.description: Where the numbers came from, in priority order: transcript (folded jsonl, the only source that covers subagents), otlp (telemetry collector), estimate (chars/4 heuristic). Mandatory — an unlabelled receipt cannot be graded EXACT/PARTIAL/SIMULATED (§46), and estimate values must never be mixed into a measured aggregate.

thinking_tokens.description: Optional. Thinking tokens (output_tokens_details.thinking_tokens); absent for a model or entry that reports none — absent is not the same statement as 0.

requests.description: Optional. Distinct requestId count for the attempt (lane 2 §2.4). Not available when source is estimate.

timing.description: Attempt timing. Lane 2 §4.5: derivable per entry from the transcript timestamp field (measured).

outcome.description: Attempt outcome. Success@1, Retry Waste and Escalation Rescue fold from this block (ARTIBOT-5.0-DESIGN.md §8.2 §4·§42). status and verifier_result are deliberately left as free strings: §42 fixes no vocabulary for them, and inventing one here would collide with the review verdict vocabulary owned elsewhere (T-17). Whoever fixes those vocabularies should add the allowlist here in the same change.

status.description: Terminal status of the attempt. Vocabulary NOT fixed by §42 — see the block description.

verifier_result.description: Optional. Result reported by the verifier for this attempt. Vocabulary NOT fixed by §42.

accepted.description: Whether the outcome was accepted. Explicitly nullable and required: lane 2 §2.5 records that no user-acceptance signal exists yet, so null means 'not labelled' and must never be silently read as false. Cost per Accepted Outcome is only computable over the labelled subset.

cost.description: Attempt cost. total is nullable by design: lane 2 §3 decision 1 records that the catalog price table and cache-roi.js disagree by roughly 3x, and until one source of truth is chosen a writer must emit null rather than an unverified number. pricing_version is required either way, so a later backfill knows which table produced (or failed to produce) the value.

total.description: Total cost from the catalog unit price times the usage counters, or null when the price table is unverified.

pricing_version.description: Identifier of the price table used. Mandatory (lane 2 §4.5), including when total is null.

model_identity.description: Exact model identity (§20, §42). Duplicated verbatim in route-receipt.schema.json; the T-19 common meta fragment is the intended future home. version (not the §20 spelling snapshot_or_version) is the canonical key — lane 2 §4.5 flags that document inconsistency and resolves it in favour of §42.

provider.description: e.g. anthropic. Left a free string: the field exists precisely because a non-Anthropic provider is possible (§59 vLLM reference).

tier.description: Artibot tier alias. Allowlist grounded in the lib/core/model-catalog.js MODELS keys (measured 2026-09-02: haiku, sonnet, opus, fable).

model_id.description: Exact provider model id from model-catalog.js (e.g. claude-fable-5-1), never the tier alias.

version.description: Provider snapshot/version string for the model id.

catalog_version.description: Version of the Artibot model catalog the identity was resolved against. PREREQUISITE: lib/core/model-catalog.js exports no CATALOG_VERSION today (repo-wide grep 0 excluding node_modules, measured 2026-09-02), so that constant must be added before a writer can populate this field.
